name: absensi-bon-cloudflare
description: Deploy one owner-managed Absensi & Bon workspace with its own Worker, D1, and private R2.

DB.description: Create a new D1 database for this workspace only.

PHOTOS.description: Create a new private R2 bucket for attendance photos. Do not enable public access.

OWNER_SETUP_TOKEN_SHA256.description: The 64-character hexadecimal SHA-256 of your one-time setup token. Provide the digest only; enter the raw token only when claiming the workspace in Flutter.
